title: Additivity of the product noise operator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $Ω$ be a finite set with probability mass function $π$, and let $\rho\in[0,1]$. For any real-valued functions $f,g$ on $Ω^n$, applying the product noise operator at parameter $\rho$ to $f+g$ gives the sum of its applications to $f$ and to $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $π$ is a probability mass function on $Ω$
